# GPT Realtime Assistant — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Low-latency 58-language bidirectional live voice interpreter, photo/screen-aware AI voice assistant, and 17-template meeting workspace for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with offline Whisper + Qwen 3 8B support on Apple Silicon.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/gpt-realtime-assistant-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/gpt-realtime-assistant-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, macOS
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Two-way live voice interpretation across 58 languages plus hands-free photo and screen-aware AI voice sessions.
- 17 structured meeting, interview, lecture, and field-note summary templates with local history control.
- Optional 100% local offline speech recognition (Whisper) and Qwen 3 8B LLM inference on Apple Silicon Macs with explicit model lifecycle state.
- Dual technical portals at realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com and gpt-realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://gpt-realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gpt-realtime-assistant/id6770536523): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/articles/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
